pr_title: Let a pull request name its summary template

comments.comment: summarise joins the template name from the pull request's own .summary/settings.json onto the checkout and reads it on a runner that holds a write token; a name with .. escapes .summary/, reads the checkout's .git/config or the process environment, and posts it as the pull request's comment.
comments.failureScenario: A pull request adds .summary/settings.json holding {"template": "../.git/config"}. join("pr", ".summary", "../.git/config") normalises to pr/.git/config, where actions/checkout wrote the job's token in the http.https://github.com/.extraheader line, and main.ts posts the file as the pull request's comment, so a token that can write to the repository is published on the pull request. "../../../../proc/self/environ" posts GITHUB_TOKEN from the environment the same way.
